ministry_names.legal_basis: 정부조직법 법률 제3854호 (effective 1987-01-01, 제29조② 장관은 국무위원으로 보하고, 제40조 육운·항공·해사와 관광) in force at the window start. Abolished by 법률 제4831호 (promulgated and in force 1994-12-23, 부칙 제1조 단서 and 제2조①) and 대통령령 제14447호 건설교통부와그소속기관직제 부칙 제2조 (교통부와그소속기관직제 폐지). Merged with 건설부 into 건설교통부 (land lineage), with 관광 moving to 문화체육부 (culture lineage). The office existed from 1948-11-04 (국가기록원 OG0018594), so the 차규헌 spell (from 1986-08-27) is under the same name. No deputy PM title.

spells.notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25, a caretaker holdover with one day in the window. Named in the 8·26 reshuffle of 1986, announced on the morning of 1986-08-26 and reported as 임명발령 that day (경향신문 1986-08-26). He received the 임명장 on the morning of 1986-08-27 with the other new ministers except the absent 외무부장관, and the 교통부 이·취임식 with his predecessor 孫守益 was held at 11:00 the same day. The start follows the 임명장 day, which ko.wikipedia also gives, and is medium because the announcement came the day before (see issues). The same date is used for 최광수, 이웅희 and 허문도 in the foreign, culture and unification ext88 files. He left with the whole 김정렬 cabinet, which resigned en bloc after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24. 노태우 accepted the resignations on the morning of 1988-02-25 and gave the new cabinet, with 이범준 at 교통부, the 임명장 the same morning, so the handover is same-day. ko.wikipedia gives 1988-02-24 as the last day. 헌법 제10호 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution (offices_1988.json holdovers_1988). Hanja from 동아일보 1986-08-26. spells.notes: First 교통부장관 of the 노태우 government. Named by the President-elect on 1988-02-19 as a sitting 민정당 member and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1988-02-25 after the inauguration, together with the PM 서리 and the 23 ministers of the new cabinet. Replaced in the 12·5 개각 of 1988. The 이현재 cabinet handed in a collective resignation at an early 국무회의 on the morning of 1988-12-05, which he attended, and the new ministers, 김창근 among them, received the 임명장 that afternoon, so the handover is same-day. The ministry had expected him to stay (동아일보 1988-12-05). ko.wikipedia gives 1988-12-04. Birth date 1928-05-30 and gender (남) from na_members_12_22.csv (NA-API), matching ko.wikipedia '이범준 (1928년)' (secondary), https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=39788601 (revid 39788601), snapshot roster/sources/transport/ext88/persons/kowiki_이범준.json (accessed 2026-09-26T13:01:04-0400). spells.notes: Named and given the 임명장 on 1988-12-05 (12·5 전면개각, 임명장 in the afternoon). Retained in the 7·19 개각 of 1989 and the 12·27 보각 of 1989, neither of which touched 교통부 (see continuity). Replaced in the 3·17 개각 of 1990. The 강영훈 cabinet resigned en bloc at the 국무회의 of 1990-03-16, and he said goodbye to his staff that morning. The reshuffle was announced on the morning of 1990-03-17, and he held a short farewell at 10:15 that day (동아일보 1990-03-17). His successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19. No dated acceptance of his resignation was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), as in the agriculture, energy, finance, interior, justice, science and sports ext88 files for the same reshuffle. The alternative end 1990-03-17 is in issues. ko.wikipedia gives 1990-03-18. spells.notes: Named in the 3·17 개각 of 1990 (announced on the morning of 1990-03-17) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19 with the other new ministers. The start follows the 임명장 day and is medium because the announcement came two days before (see issues). ko.wikipedia also gives 1990-03-19. Retained in the 9·19 부분개각 of 1990, which changed only 농림수산, 건설 and 환경처 (continuity). Replaced in the 12·27 개각 of 1990. He came to work as usual on the morning of 1990-12-27, the reshuffle was announced that morning, and the new ministers, 임인택 among them, received the 임명장 that afternoon, so the handover is same-day. Former 총무처 차관, 전남지사 and 내무차관. ko.wikipedia has no article on him (the list links a missing page '김창식 (정치인)') and no Wikidata item was found, so birth_date is null. The press gave his age as 61 in March 1990, 경향신문 1990-03-17 p.1 '交通(교통)<新(신)>金昶植(김창식)(61)' (Naver News Library article 1990031700329201019, OCR text, page image https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990031700329201019&editNo=3&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-03-17&officeId=00032&pageNo=1&printNo=13684&publishType=00020), POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1990031700329201019, snapshot roster/sources/transport/ext88/news/nl/nl_1990031700329201019.json (accessed 2026-09-26T13:23:01-0400). spells.notes: Named on the morning of 1990-12-27 (12·27 개각, 국무총리서리 노재봉) and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Retained in the partial reshuffles of 1991-02-18, 1991-05-26 and 1991-12-19 (continuity). In the last one he had been considered for replacement and was kept (조선일보 1991-12-20). Replaced on 1992-03-30. He learned of it by a telephone call from PM 정원식 at lunch and held a three-minute 이임식 at 16:00 that day, and his successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1992-03-31. No dated acceptance of his resignation was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor), which ko.wikipedia also gives. The interior and agriculture ext88 files end 이상연 and 조경식 on 1992-03-31 in the same way. The alternative end 1992-03-30 is in issues. Later 건설교통부장관 2001-09-29 to 2003-02-27 (land.verified.json, same hanja and birth date). Birth date from ko.wikipedia '임인택' (secondary), https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42046536 (revid 42046536), snapshot roster/sources/transport/ext88/persons/kowiki_임인택.json (accessed 2026-09-25T13:36:42-0400). Text: ''''임인택'''(林寅澤, [[1940년]] [[6월 8일]]'. spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of 1992-03-30 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1992-03-31. The start follows the 임명장 day and is medium because the announcement came the day before (see issues). ko.wikipedia also gives 1992-03-31. Retained in the 6·25 개각 of 1992 and in the 중립내각 of 1992-10-09, when the resignations of the retained ministers were returned (continuity). A 노태우 holdover after 김영삼 took office on 1993-02-25. 총무처 held that ministers had no fixed term, did not need to resign en bloc and would hand over when the new President appointed successors (매일경제 1993-02-24). The new cabinet was announced on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received the 임명장 that afternoon. No farewell or 면직 date for him was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor). ko.wikipedia gives 1993-02-25 (see issues). spells.notes: First 교통부장관 of the 김영삼 government, named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Dismissed (해임) on the morning of 1993-10-18 in answer to the 서해훼리호 sinking of 1993-10-10, together with the 해운항만청장, on the PM's recommendation that morning. His successor received the 임명장 the same morning, so the handover is same-day. No 이임식 report was found. ko.wikipedia has no article on him (the list links a missing page) and no Wikidata item was found, so birth_date is null. The press gave his age as 56 in February 1993, BigKinds full text: 국민일보 1993-02-26 '부총리 이경식(경제)·한완상(통일)씨/김 대통령 조각발표' (news_id 01100201.19930226000000101, GET https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100201.19930226000000101&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000), snapshot roster/sources/transport/ext88/news/bk/bk_01100201.19930226000000101.json (accessed 2026-09-26T09:31:34-0400). spells.notes: Named and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1993-10-18 after the dismissal of 이계익. On the afternoon of 1993-12-21 he was named 부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 in the 12·21 개각 (14개 부처) and 오명 was named to 교통부. Both received the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1993-12-22. The end is that day, when the successor and he himself were appointed (inferred_from_successor). end_reason 'other' = moved to another cabinet post. The 경제기획원 spell starting 1993-12-22 is in epb.ext88.json, so the two lineages share the handover day. ko.wikipedia gives 1993-12-21. spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of 1993-12-21 and given the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1993-12-22. The start follows the 임명장 day and is medium because the announcement came the day before (see issues). The environment, interior, general_affairs and defense ext88 files also start their 12·21 appointees on 1993-12-22. Retained through the PM changes of 1994-04 and 1994-12-17 and the partial reshuffle of 1994-10-04 (continuity). The last 교통부장관. 교통부 was merged with 건설부 into 건설교통부 when 법률 제4831호 and its 직제 took effect on 1994-12-23, and the end follows the office's last day in offices_1988.json. The act was in fact promulgated at about 14:00 on 1994-12-23, and all ministers except the PM handed in a collective resignation at the 국무회의 held before it (국민일보 1994-12-23), so he was legally 교통부장관 until that afternoon. The same convention is used for 홍재형 (epb) and 박재윤 (finance). The President named him 건설교통부장관 on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 (동아일보 1994-12-24 still calls him 교통부장관). He received the new 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24 and held the 건설교통부 취임식 that afternoon. That spell belongs to the land lineage (see issues). ko.wikipedia gives 1994-12-23. issues.desc: Start-date convention for reshuffles announced before the 임명장. Pre-2001 there is no gazette file. This file starts each spell on the 임명장 day and ends a replaced minister on the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor) when no dated acceptance was found. Split cases, announcement -> 임명장, are 차규헌 1986-08-26 -> 08-27 (reported as 임명발령 on 08-26), 김창식 1990-03-17 -> 03-19, 노건일 1992-03-30 -> 03-31 and 오명 1993-12-21 -> 12-22, each with start_confidence 'medium' and the announcement day as nomination_date. For two predecessors the farewell came before that day. 김창근 said goodbye on 1990-03-16 and held a farewell at 10:15 on 1990-03-17 (the cabinet had resigned en bloc on 1990-03-16), and 임인택 held his 이임식 at 16:00 on 1992-03-30. If the announcement day were the legal date, 김창근 would end on 1990-03-17 with 1990-03-18 vacant and 임인택 would end on 1992-03-30. The rule matches the agriculture, energy, finance, interior, justice, science and sports ext88 files, while epb.ext88.json ends 조순 on 1990-03-17.

노건일's end is 1993-02-26 (successor's 임명장 day), while ko.wikipedia gives 1993-02-25, the inauguration day. 총무처 held that ministers need not resign at the change of President and would hand over when successors were appointed (매일경제 1993-02-24), and 매일경제 1993-02-26 calls him the 전임 of 이계익. No 이임식 or 면직 date was found in the News Library or BigKinds (searches '盧健一' and '노건일' 1993-02-22..03-05, '노건일 이임'). The education ext88 file ends 조완규 on 1993-02-25 for the same transition, and most other ext88 files use 1993-02-26.

오명's 교통부 spell ends on 1994-12-22, the office's last day in offices_1988.json, although 법률 제4831호 took effect at about 14:00 on 1994-12-23 and he handed in a collective resignation with the other ministers at the 국무회의 before it (국민일보 1994-12-23). He was named 초대 건설교통부장관 on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 and received that 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24 (경향신문 1994-12-24, 헤럴드경제 1994-12-24, 국제신문 1994-12-24), with the 취임식 that afternoon (한겨레 1994-12-25). The 건설교통부 spell belongs to the land lineage, which should record it from 1994-12-24 and set reorg_continuation or reappointed_on_reorg there. 1994-12-23 has no appointed 건설교통부장관 unless the land file treats the day as a continuation. No land ext88 file existed when this file was built. ko.wikipedia ends his 교통부 term on 1994-12-23.

No tier-2 holder list exists for 교통부. molit lists only 건설교통부 from 1994-12 (SOURCES_TOOLKIT.md, pre-2001 section 5). The holder list is taken from ko.wikipedia '대한민국 교통부' (tier 4) and confirmed with day-of news for every change and every reshuffle in between (continuity). Two tier-3 sequence checks agree with it. 동아일보 1991-02-22 lists the 5共 and 6共 교통부장관 in order ending with 車圭憲 李範俊 金昌槿 金昶植 林寅澤, and 조선일보 1992-04-01 counts 35 ministers before 노건일, which matches the list's 36대 for him. 국민일보 1990-03-17 '6공화국 개각 일지' shows no 교통 change in the reshuffles of 1988-03-07, 1988-05-07, 1989-07-19 and 1989-12-27.

Person data gaps. 김창식 and 이계익 have no ko.wikipedia article and no Wikidata item was found, so birth_date is null for both. The press gave their ages as 61 (March 1990) and 56 (February 1993). Wikidata gives only the year 1940 for 임인택 and 노건일, and ko.wikipedia's full dates are used. All birth dates except 이범준's (NA-API) are secondary. Gender is from press profiles (mention of a wife), Wikidata or NA-API. name_en is the Wikidata English label where one exists (임인택, 정재석, 오명). land.verified.json (임인택) and science.verified.json (오명) have name_en null for the same persons, and epb.ext88.json uses 'Chung Jai-suk' as here.

Source misprints. 대한민국사연표 1986-08-26 prints 차규헌 as '차주헌', 조선일보 1990-10-26 prints 金昶植 as 金昌植, and the 문화일보 1993-02-27 caption OCR reads 金洙三 for 金泳三. The two 1990 profiles of 김창식 spell his wife's name 김남인 and 김남임. None affects a date.

Cross-lineage handovers on the same day. 정재석's 교통부 spell ends on 1993-12-22 and his 경제기획원 spell in epb.ext88.json starts the same day. 오명's 교통부 spell ends 1994-12-22 and his 건설교통부 spell (land) should start 1994-12-24. 임인택 reappears as 건설교통부장관 2001-09-29 in land.verified.json with the same hanja and birth date.

continuity.note: No vacancy inside 1986-08-27..1994-12-22. Every handover is same-day or ends the outgoing minister on the successor's 임명장 day, so no acting head is recorded. The five cases where the announcement preceded the 임명장 (1986-08, 1990-03, 1992-03, 1993-12, and 1988-02 for a new government) are in issues.
